# owner: platform
"""Short text notices for parents."""

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def _absent_days(student, marks):
    if any(mark.student_id != student.student_id for mark in marks):
        raise ProjectError("marks belong to a different student")
    days = sorted(mark.day for mark in marks if mark.status == "absent")
    if not days:
        raise ProjectError("no absences to report")
    return days


# ---
def build_absence_notice(student, marks):
    days = _absent_days(student, marks)
    dates = ", ".join(when.isoformat() for when in days)
    count = len(days)
    word = "day" if count == 1 else "days"
    return f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name} missed {count} {word}: {dates}."
